name: gpa-floor
description: Cumulative GPA below 3.0: the §2.2 floor is unmet and the defense rows carry the 'may not defend' gate note. Since 2026-10-03 (P1-gpa-8) the coursework comes before the EXAM (§4.5), the 3.0 before ADMISSION to candidacy (§2.2) — and since 2026-10-04 (DGS: “OCE and doctoral candidacy are two different things”) the 3.0 is on the admission row, not the OCE row.

detailIncludes: You can take the exam once your 24 regular-course credits are complete or in progress — you have 3 of 24 (§4.5)
Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or better: 2.90 — below it
